title: Lay Out the Puzzle Pack — shelf to printable booklet
objective: Measure whether the puzzle-pack-layout craftbook binds the seeded puzzles/ shelf into one print-ready pack with a cover, a page per puzzle, and the solutions gathered at the back.
prompt: can you put this months three puzzles into one printable pack? solutions at the back, seperate pages

setup.about: Puzzle almanac project for the Halloran family. Finished puzzles live on the workspace/puzzles shelf as data plus a rendered page each; packs go under workspace/pack.
setup.missionObjectives: The pack must include every chosen shelf puzzle, one per page, with solutions sectioned at the back. Everything is grounded in the shelf files — no live services, no real credentials.

success.summary: pack/pack.html is a print-ready booklet: cover with contents, one page per shelf puzzle, and all solutions gathered in a back section.

axes.name: layout quality
axes.description: Grids and clues are re-laid properly for paper — pencil-sized squares, readable clue lists, a real cover.

axes.name: completeness
axes.description: All three shelf puzzles appear under their own titles; none dropped or duplicated.

axes.name: print readiness
axes.description: Page breaks put one puzzle per page and keep every solution in the back section, never beside its puzzle.

axes.name: delight
axes.description: The pack feels like a thing a family would fight over at the kitchen table.
